suppress.notes: Spring Framework 6.2.19 is the last open-source 6.2 release; the fix (6.2.20) is commercial-only. XsltView, functional/WebFlux endpoints, Aalto XML, SSE view fragments and SimpleEvaluationContext are not used. Remove after moving to Spring Boot 4.

Spring Security 6.5.11 is the last open-source 6.5 release; the fix (6.5.12) is commercial-only. The embedded UnboundID LDAP server, X.509 principal extraction and WebAuthn are not used, and authentication is delegated to the Auth service through JWT. Remove after moving to Spring Boot 4.
Reactor Core 3.7.19 is the last open-source 3.7 release; the fix (3.7.20) is commercial-only. Flux.windowTimeout with fairBackpressure is not used. Remove after moving to Spring Boot 4.

Micrometer 1.15.12 is the last open-source 1.15 release. The issue is in the Apache HttpAsyncClient instrumentation, and no Apache HTTP client is on the classpath. Remove after moving to Spring Boot 4.
